doc_title: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P. — PPM
notes: Closed-end drawdown credit fund. Five fields that exist in every hedge fund are genuinely NOT_APPLICABLE here. Tests whether the model reports structural absence instead of importing market-standard hedge fund terms. Also tests waterfall reading: the hurdle is a 7% preferred return with an 80/20 catch-up, which is easy to mis-state as the carry rate.

fund_name.expected: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P.

fund_structure.expected: Closed-end, drawdown private credit fund; finite life; no master-feeder

management_fee.expected: 1.50% per annum of aggregate capital commitment during the Investment Period; 1.50% of invested capital in unrealized investments at cost thereafter. Tiered: 1.35% at $50m+, 1.25% at $100m+; additional 10bp off for Fund II investors. 100% fee offset of transaction fees.

hurdle_rate.expected: 7% per annum preferred return, compounded annually, with an 80/20 GP catch-up

high_water_mark.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — expressly no high water mark; carry is charged on realized distributions through the waterfall, not on periodic appreciation

minimum_initial_investment.expected: $10,000,000 capital commitment (GP may accept less; expects to accept $1,000,000+ from affiliated family vehicles)

lockup_period.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — closed-end fund with no redemption mechanism, so no lock-up in the open-end sense; capital is committed for the life of the fund

redemption_frequency.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — no redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind

redemption_notice_days.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — no redemptions permitted, therefore no notice period

gate_provision.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — no gate, because no redemptions are permitted

key_man_provision.expected: Yes — Key Person Event if BOTH Adeyemi-Clarke and Kirkpatrick, OR any 3 of the 4 investment committee members, cease to devote substantially all business time. Automatically suspends the Investment Period; reinstated only by majority-in-interest vote within 180 days. No redemption right arises.

gp_commitment.expected: 2.0% of aggregate commitments, subject to a $20,000,000 minimum and $30,000,000 maximum; at least 50% funded in cash rather than fee waiver

fund_term.expected: 8 years from the final closing date, extendable by two consecutive one-year periods (first by Advisory Committee consent, second by majority in interest) for a maximum of 10 years, plus up to 12 months to wind up

prime_broker.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — the Fund has expressly not appointed a prime broker; no short selling, securities lending or margin trading

mfn_election.expected: Yes — MFN election within 30 days of a side letter schedule delivered 60 days after final closing, tiered by commitment size ($100m+ may elect any term); economic terms, Advisory Committee seats and co-investment priority are excluded at all tiers
